description: The AgentGid card of an Agent Skills pack (ponytail, elayadesign/ai-design-skills ...), checked against the pack's own files at a pinned commit: what it does in plain words and for whom, each skill with whether it changes files, official install and uninstall commands per agent, what runs on the user's machine (hooks, files written, network), things to know before installing, the author's numbers marked as reported. Use find_skills to search, then get_skill before installing a pack.

skill.description: owner/repo, pack name or a skill name, e.g. DietrichGebert/ponytail, ponytail-review

name: get_skill
title: Agent Skills pack card
